sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max: A New Bar for Coding and Cowork
sources.snippet: It first spent ~37 hours rebuilding the paper's full pipeline from zero and reproduced its six main findings — repeatedly fine-tuning a Qwen3-8B model on the data it selected and confirming the gains on hard math benchmarks (for instance, the paper's selection method beats picking data at random by +7.7% on AIME24).
